text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The deserted island project brought the curtain down on its three years of activities.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Balancing both was tough, but...
now that it's over, I feel kind of lonely after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right? Just doing the work was pretty great training in itself,
so in that sense, it feels kinda lonely now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Right?
I wonder how Tucker-san is doing?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I was training over there yesterday,
and she was laughing at the top of her lungs, same as always!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I got a message the other day asking me to teach them how to use Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Though I ended up having to explain
the difference between Umastagram and UmaTube.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: They don't even know what LANE is after all...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Fufu. But apparently, they want to take that kind of thing in and make that place even, even, even better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I can totally picture them
screaming at the top of their lungs!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's true! Tucker-san is always so pushy, passionate, weird—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
They were such a dazzling adult.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm really glad
I took part in the uninhabited island project.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days rolled by—
until one balmy afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was this poster always here?
What's this, deserted island...—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tucker Brine's challenge
is far from over.
